scope: Spline kinematic-sampling sub_y_3, 3D BC_RC_Bayesian only, on a copy of alternatives/spline/sub_y_3/histograms.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: the BC_RC keys these 452 histograms select have median B width 0.17 and only 5 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.10 with 10 narrower than 0.05, so those windows are not tight. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the run-local copy of the universal spline file and the corrected filled-window range. 450 selected spline keys match the manual keys that made the stored fit, so those histograms did not move. (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) is the spline 3D-BC key rather than the tighter manual BC key, and that pass lowered its chi-squared ((Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 41.762 to 36.407). (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_32) already sat inside the wider spline window and did not move. Pass 2 opened only the histograms whose own cosine was outside the guide or was stuck in the rough-start window, including the legacy (1, 8) and (1, 9) BC limits. It did not copy nominal parameters. JSON still has 452 bins. 29 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher by more than 0.05. Largest drops: (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 136.548 to 27.830; (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_15) 47.604 to 23.061; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_29) 43.014 to 21.961; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_5) 55.255 to 35.354; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16) 22.148 to 7.693; (Q2_y_Bin_10)-(z_pT_Bin_11) 22.735 to 13.162; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_33) 12.557 to 3.987; (Q2_y_Bin_11)-(z_pT_Bin_20) 41.776 to 33.854. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) was stored at the second-pass edge B=-0.045 from the legacy BC limits [-0.03, 0.05] and C [0, 0.1]. It is kept at B=-0.125923, statistical error 0.048563, C=-0.056919, error 0.042028, chi-squared 16.547, NDF 13.0, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal BC B=-0.116016 and not the acceptance B=-0.125191.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) B=-0.251283 versus nominal -0.329563, shift +0.078279, cosine chi-squared left 0.000; (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) B=-0.275656 versus nominal -0.347901, shift +0.072246, cosine chi-squared left 0.000; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_22) B=0.006202 versus nominal -0.044242, shift +0.050444, cosine chi-squared left 0.000. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. Missing comparisons were not filled with zero. The y subdivision source was not removed.
unresolved: No retained bin is still more than 1 chi-squared above its own unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 4.115 (chi2 61.720, NDF 15); (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 3.963 (chi2 79.262, NDF 20); (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) 3.771 (chi2 79.190, NDF 21). (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is not unresolved as a guide miss. Isolated spikes that the cosine already follows: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) pull 5.10 at 352 deg, fraction 0.62; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 7.40 at 352 deg, fraction 0.79; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) pull 6.37 at 352 deg, fraction 0.51. why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 29 are lower by more than 0.05, and the curves follow each sub_y_3 histogram. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. Near-zero parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic.
